reason: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin that lets users choose a working context window and conservatively clamps model settings to known local capacity limits.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作窗口设置页，帮助用户选择上下文窗口并按本地已知模型容量限制配置值。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings page for choosing a working context window and clamping model configuration to known local capacity limits.

capabilities: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings page for selecting a shared context window
Updates model and route context-window settings through settings.mutate
Reads installed local model catalog ceilings to clamp configured values
